claim_ceiling: Plan only. No engine, witness topology, protocol or physical durability profile is qualified by this manifest.

commit_protocols.authority_order: Database transaction commits a candidate state; an independent witness quorum then accepts its canonical state digest and transition bundle.
commit_protocols.authoritative_ack_condition: A client may be told authoritative success only after the witness write quorum has durably signed the exact accepted transition and the required projection state is confirmed.
commit_protocols.failure_semantics: A local DB commit without a witness quorum is an un-attested candidate, not authoritative success. The next writer must reconcile or quarantine it. Witness timeout is indeterminate until receipt lookup resolves it.

commit_protocols.authority_order: Witness quorum commits an immutable transition receipt and content-addressed bundle; the selected database backend applies the certified transition as a projection.
commit_protocols.authoritative_ack_condition: A client may be told authoritative success after the witness receipt is quorum-certified and the projection has applied it or a verifiable deterministic rebuild path is retained and admitted by policy.
commit_protocols.failure_semantics: A witness-committed receipt with a projection write failure remains accepted authority state but the projection is unavailable/incomplete. Recovery replays the immutable bundle idempotently.

commit_protocols.authority_order: Witness quorum assigns the next authority sequence to a compare-and-advance intent; deterministic transition evaluation emits the accepted state digest and receipt; database projections consume the ordered result.
commit_protocols.authoritative_ack_condition: A client may be told authoritative success only after the quorum has committed the unique transition decision and its receipt is retrievable from the independent ledger.
commit_protocols.failure_semantics: At most one transition may consume a given predecessor under the same authority scope. Conflicting proposals receive compare-conflict. Quorum loss fails closed; no DB-local fallback becomes authoritative.
